data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 盛夏故障与冰镇汽水
data.description: 实验室的老旧空调突然停摆，热浪让空气泛起微光。红莉栖用冰凉的汽水罐贴在泛红的脸颊上降温，吊带衫贴着锁骨，转头投来带着嗔怪的无奈视线。
data.location: sweltering summer lab room with spinning ceiling fan and half-drawn blinds
data.action: sitting on wooden stool pressing chilled condensation-beaded soda can to her flushed cheek, bare shoulders gleaming, rolling eyes with affectionate exasperation
data.lighting: blinding summer sunlight slicing through venetian blinds casting striped patterns
data.mood: youthful summer domesticity, playful exasperation, vivid sensual warmth
data.promptProse: In a hot sunlit room, Kurisu presses an ice-cold beverage can against her flushed cheek, bare shoulders catching bright beams through slatted blinds.
